item.title: Photos: Lindsey Vonn crashes in Olympic downhill
item.description: Lindsey Vonn, racing on a badly injured left knee, crashed early in the Olympic downhill on Sunday and was taken off the course by a helicopter after the 41-year-old American received medical attention on the snow for long, anguished minutes.

item.title: Super Bowl 60: Seahawks take second Super Bowl title, beating Patriots 29-13
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks bested the New England Patriots on Sunday at Super Bowl LX in a lopsided game with a historic defensive performance.

item.title: Above-average temperatures to end the weekend with a pattern change to start out the week
item.description: Happy Sunday, Utah! We will be in store for another warm and dry one today with high pressure remaining in place through the evening hours.

item.title: Silver Alert: 65-year-old woman reported missing out of St. George
item.description: A Silver Alert has been activated for a 65-year-old woman reported missing out of St. George, according to the Utah Dept. of Public Safety (DPS).

item.title: 3 shot in South Salt Lake, 1 in critical condition
item.description: Three people were shot in South Salt Lake early Sunday morning, according to South Salt Lake Police. One of those individuals is reportedly in critical condition.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn 'stable' after harrowing crash in Winter Olympic downhill
item.description: Lindsey Vonn could be heard screaming after the frightening crash.

item.title: 2 arrested after rocks thrown at vehicles in St. George area, thousands in damage
item.description: Two people have been arrested after rocks were thrown at vehicles in the St. George area, causing thousands in damage, according to St. George Police.

item.title: One seriously injured after shots fired near David Gourley Park
item.description: One person is seriously injured after being shot at David Gourley Park in Salt Lake City.

item.title: Utah 2034 hosts reception for Team USA families during first week of Italy 2026 Winter Games
item.description: The Utah 2034 organizing committee hosted a reception for family members of Team USA athletes at the Italy 2026 Winter Games.

item.title: 'Heated Rivalry' screenings are coming to the Utah Pride Center
item.description: 'Heated Rivalry,' the HBO Max show centering two rival hockey players who develop complicated feelings for each other, is taking the world by storm, and Utah is not immune to the charm. On Thursday, Feb. 12, the Utah Pride Center is partnering with Seniors Out and Proud to bring screenings of the show to Salt Lake City.
